verdict.rationale: Rippling's own pages say it automatically and instantly provisions and revokes access, including account provisioning, group access and access levels via dynamic rules. It also says it federates to custom SCIM and SAML apps and updates access, permissions and groups when roles change. These claims cover the core of the story: users, groups and entitlements pushed downstream in real time. missing for 10: in-depth SCIM documentation (supported apps, attribute and entitlement mapping, push timing details), independent or hands-on corroboration that downstream accounts create themselves on assignment.
